subject: Unable to access HTTP Request header information inside RShiny

messages.author: 75d98917e2bf37bc
messages.subject: Unable to access HTTP Request header information inside RShiny
parts:
I am using apache module to authenticate our users against LDAP and using ProxyPass and ProxyPassReverse to forward the requests from apache to RShiny server. I am adding logged in username as a RequestHeader (HTTP_USERNAME) and want to access the user's information inside RShiny server using session object. However I am having trouble in accessing the added header inside RShiny Server

Here is the apache config 

ProxyPass /shiny http://shiny:3838
ProxyPassReverse /shiny http://shiny:3838
RequestHeader set HTTP_username %{AUTHENTICATE_sAMAccountName}e

Inside server.R
txt <- session$request$HTTP_USERNAME


Am I missing any thing here. Any help is greatly appreciated.

Thanks.

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Unable to access HTTP Request header information inside RShiny
parts: Arbitrary HTTP headers are stripped for security reasons--Shiny communicates over websockets which are not susceptible to same origin policy so in general these requests cannot be trusted not to have originated from a malicious website. However in the case where you're absolutely certain a header can be trusted, there is a configuration option in Shiny Server Pro (only) that will let you allow whitelists of headers to make them available in Shiny: https://rstudio.github.io/shiny-server/latest/#proxied-headers
